name: Medianeira (Brazil)
description: Horizontal stripes of red, white, dark blue, white and red, the broad blue stripe charged with two white stars.
history: Medianeira is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag was designed by the vexillologist and heraldist Arthur Luponi and prescribed with the arms by Municipal Law No. 60 of 30 December 1976; the dark red recalls the reddish earth of Medianeira, the white the spirit of peace and the blue the sky.
